ios.desc:
Never Miss Your Ring Schedule Again. Lunella is the beautifully simple contraceptive ring tracker designed for real life. With a discreet home screen widget, you'll always know your current status at a glance—no need to open the app. Why Women Love Lunella: At-a-Glance Widget – See your IN or OUT status instantly on your home screen with a subtle, elegant design. Discreet & Private – Your cycle information stays private. No accounts, no data sharing, just you and your schedule. Automatic Tracking – Set your start date once, and Lunella handles the rest with automatic 28-day cycle tracking. Beautiful Design – A thoughtfully designed interface that respects both your privacy and aesthetic 

How It Works:
Set your cycle start date
Add the widget to your home screen
Check your status anytime with a quick glance
Never worry about forgetting again

Perfect For:
NuvaRing® users
Anyone using a 28-day contraceptive ring schedule (7 days out, 21 days in)
Women who want a simple, reliable tracking solution

Your Privacy Matters Lunella stores all data locally on your device. No cloud sync, no accounts, no tracking. Your health information belongs to you. Lunella is a tracking tool and should be used alongside, not as a replacement for, professional medical advice. Always follow your healthcare provider's instructions.

quotes.text: My wife said she wished there was a big widget on her phone that told her when to take her Nuvaring out. So I vibe coded one. What other problems can it solve?
